notes.title: Next update is coming!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=lYqb3iFBi8o;full][/previewyoutube]

Here is Evelynn's room that will be used to conclude day and night cycles and also for the main menu

I'm deeply sorry for such a delay - I haven't been able to work on the project for 2 weeks straight, and only now I'm catching up. Because of all this instability, I can't promise an update on a certain date but I will say that it will be focused primarily on Story content.

Thank you so much for your feedback and activity^^

notes.title: PrisonBreak Update!
notes.content:
[h1]Break out of prison![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839405/8510b65f52a9503196a3cb75efa823816e6facc1.jpg[/img]
Now spawn location at the start of the game is moved to the point below the castle in a lonely prison cell our way begins! 
[list]
[*] NEW HUGE location added under the main Castle
[*] New arenas!
[*] New platforming challenges!
[*] Tutorial prompts that will introduce you to the controls
[*] BugFixes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839405/6ebd2c23b403e1b25b539fca4781d4ee73d0a057.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839405/6b3635e49fcea5b348aa9d401c364c5a0a9f1349.jpg[/img]

I hope you will love this new section ^^~

[h2][b]What comes next[/b][/h2]

The next HUGE update will be a bit smaller in the next week, it will bring
[list]
[*] Main Menu and improved in-game Menu
[*] Steam Achievements! 
[*] Boss Ringmaster fixes
[*] New weapons
[*] New Enemies
[*] More Dialogues
[*] First Hangout event!
[*]  and even more
[/list]

notes.title: Only one month till release!
notes.content:
Drealegy's release is just around the corner! 

The game will be live on the 28th of March in Early Access. 
“At the start of Early access there would be:
[list]
[*] 2 Characters in the band
[*] 1 [i]Biome[/i]
[*] 6 [i]weapons[/i]
[*] Start of the plot
[*] a lot and a lot of [b]Replayability[/b]
[/list]

[previewyoutube=9lyXmVTNmSg;full][/previewyoutube]

In the next post, I will announce the Starting characters in the Band and a connection to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850280/GwenBlade/]GwenBlade[/url] 

Stay tuned^^~

notes.title: Throwable Update!
notes.content:
One of the feedback on GwenBlade that I remembered was that the combat is very straightforward - go hit and dodge.

Since then I've done some interesting combat (in another game) and played a lot of different games, of which Sifu with its pick-up and drop weapons really stuck out to me.

Just so the player finds himself in a situation in which without throwing items can not make it
